allocation: one host-CPU candidate invocation followed by one separate raw-only audit; no retries

environment.container: NOT_USED: python:3.12.14-slim was not cached; C: free space fell from 316096512 bytes during preparation to 0 before formal launch; no shared Docker/OrbStack CPU allocation was granted to this experiment
environment.gpu: NOT_USED: deterministic finite method test has no GPU-dependent computation
environment.network: candidate and auditor make no network calls

H: In a finite matched-route evaluation with planted route-correlated outcome loss or task-ID misjoin but no true route benefit, a predeclared same-cohort negative-control endpoint flags the spurious contrast before promotion; a null pipeline does not trigger. Its ability to detect real benchmark bias remains unknown.

T.design: Deterministic authored no-model assignment deck; compare primary-only analysis, a pre/post reference-standard deck, and same-cohort negative controls. An independent raw-only auditor replays every row and adjudicates against a separate truth file.
T.population: 6 cases x 4 assigned task IDs x 2 routes = 48 episode rows; 6 x 2 routes x 2 phases = 24 pre/post reference rows
T.faults: route-specific missing hard outcomes; swapped observed task IDs; task-window joint primary/sentinel export error while pre/post reference samples remain correct; actual guarded-route sentinel mutation
T.controls: clean null and true primary benefit with null sentinel

D.PASS_METHOD_SCOPED: same-cohort control warns exactly on the four preregistered missingness/join/export/collateral deviations; clean-null and true-primary-benefit cases remain CLEAR; the independent oracle classifies the true sentinel mutation as COLLATERAL_FAIL rather than measurement bias; all six raw corruption controls are rejected.
D.FAIL_METHOD: a required planted measurement/join/missingness deviation is missed, clean-null or true-primary-benefit is quarantined, a real sentinel mutation is classified as mere measurement bias, raw reconstruction differs, or any corruption control is accepted.
D.UNCERTAIN: the authored independent truth/oracle or the declared route-null relation cannot distinguish export error from real collateral, or source/input identity cannot be established.

C: Ordinary all-attempt reconciliation, independent scoring, or a check-standard deck may catch the same errors more simply; a negative control can be weakly linked to the relevant bias path and create false reassurance.
U: Synthetic data do not establish that a real route cannot affect a sentinel, that the sentinel shares a live bias path, or that the method detects endpoint-specific primary-only errors. The small deterministic deck gives no sensitivity, prevalence, causal, integrated #57, GUI, model, safety, or product estimate. The audit oracle is authored fixture truth, not an empirical independent assessor.

decision_gates.must_not_overinterpret: a control warning means NEEDS_INDEPENDENT_AUDIT; the control alone does not label bias or prove the primary contrast invalid
decision_gates.reference_deck: pre/post deck is measured as its own comparator; task-window-only injected export error intentionally leaves fixed bracketing checks green
decision_gates.threshold: exact nonzero finite contrast for binary outcomes; no statistical significance test or empirical-rate inference

line_ending_canonicalization: The GitHub Contents connector preserves the original LF file bytes and appends one final CRLF. Frozen SHA-256 values identify the exact GitHub file bytes; the local copies are checked by appending that same final CRLF.

main_drift_check.scope: GitHub compare found intervening changes only outside research/experiments/same_cohort_negative_control_5841_t0_20261001; candidate/auditor import no repository runtime code and use only Python standard library plus frozen files.
